title: `[...catchall]` routes do not work with turbopack

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

labels.name: linear: turbopack
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Turbopack team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/Fredkiss3/turbopack-parallel-routes-bug

### To Reproduce


1.  Start the dev server with turbopack : `npm run dev -- --turbo`
2. Open the home page and navigates to`/other` using the links on the header, you will see that only the content of the parallel route in `@parallel/page.tsx` is shown when navigating
3. While on `/other` reload the page, the content will disappear, not even default.tsx is shown.


### Current vs. Expected behavior

Turbopack doesn't consider `[...catchAll]` routes and instead renders an empty content, while it works fine on webpack.


## Current behavior :
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/38298743/d23fdde6-e687-445d-9a1c-6f94f98da9fe

## Expected behavior :
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/38298743/d82d46fc-8fff-42d9-bd88-c0a37e64b251
